race.comment: Compared to the market expectation, CRUISERWEIGHT (5) was a bit disappointing when fourth at $1.80 last start at Caulfield but that support was telling off a fast win prior. Perhaps he was ridden a touch close last time, expect Zahra to take a sit midfield from a nice draw and be surging late. BUCCLEUCH (4) resumes. Two runs last time in were just fair in good company, he'd looked good as a late 2yo prior and has won a trial, respecting. TWO WOLVES (9) resumes. The form around Harry's Yacht before a spell reads well, respecting despite also drawing very wide. CHERISH ME (10) continues to race well and should take beating again.
